title: Arranging transmission fairly and concluding

captions.emotions: Relief as a shared role concludes

meaning: Continuing a chosen teaching can inspire you when fair actions taken together allow an earlier stage of participation to end peacefully.
text: You can transmit something valued while honestly concluding your own role. The Hierophant in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to continue a chosen teaching and preserve its foundations. Justice in the physical position describes shared actions: relating contributions to conditions, making clear agreements and considering consequences. Death in emotions brings the liberating relief of completion. It feels rewarding that a promise has genuinely been fulfilled and experience can develop among others. Meaning remains without endlessly restoring your earlier amount of involvement or leaving someone waiting for another compulsory personal explanation.

For example, you help the final session of a short craft course become an actual transmission of foundations together. You distinguish what is promised, where further information is available and which continuation participants can choose independently. **A fair agreement lets transmission genuinely complete its stage.** Someone leaves with an understood small skill, bringing space. Your work supports a living opportunity without keeping people inside an undefined promise to reveal the essentials later, allowing substance to continue through their own attempts and questions.

The boundary can blur if conditions continually add another compulsory stage. A simple question creates an indefinite continuation although the promised foundation could already be completed. The wish to transmit and relief remain supportive. Action benefits from an honest concrete boundary, fulfilling the promise while keeping further acquaintance accessible rather than turning preservation into endless dependence on the explainers’ former role.
